title: Remove private storage from the P104 inverse-transpose
head: bd1f069a0a7a36d8f04fe2dbe2c286cab3b2703d
body:
PR2479 explicitly leaves its new known-zero accumulator and nonzero-discard contract unadmitted. This package supplies the same finite P104 inverse-transpose using only the original 280 persistent registers: each of eight existing Q registers makes a paid cap-to-line excursion, subtracts its fixed D readers, and returns. No private allocation, COPY, discard or extra helper is used. All 72 arbitrary dirty helper values restore.

The complete 4,042-event word has 2,624 ADDs and 1,418 native transports, with rank mass 2,424: exactly eight extra H7 (56 rank units) versus PR2479. All 280 input columns agree at every macro boundary and at the endpoint; the literal inverse restores all inputs in both composition orders. Every transport is source-bound. All 748 distinct forward edges and 748 normalized inverse variants are checked for signed Pauli action and exact phase, with 8,192 complete Gaussian columns across the 16 excursion occurrences. Both directions retain one positive child per paid transport.

Validation: author CPython 3.12.14 normal and registered optimized replay; nine semantic controls; unchanged Git-free export; changed executable rejection before import; missing evidence refusal; full endpoint receipt mutation with unchanged headline counts; metadata/source pins and baseline bindings. A separate AI reviewer ran native CPython 3.12.7 optimized replay and independently reconstructed the entire word directly from the original forward witness, checking all 78,400 entries of M^T N=I without importing the candidate or PR2479 executables. No material issue was found; this is not independent human or formal-kernel verification.

This closes the finite private-storage assumption by paying for nonmonotone public paths. It does not admit their global owners, idle/residual charges, scalar/tape lowering, all-size recursion, I-G/2 correction, favorable complete moment, supplier or new kappa. PR2503 precision constants cover a different word and are not transferred. The elementary round-trip identity is credited as standard, not claimed new.

Base: canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. Exact pending source PR2479: `65e58f85d98b4a6344c6221623df1d4caa519604`; main/source/comments refreshed before finalization. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2479#issuecomment-6192876269). Proof, complete word, source pins, exact receipts, meaningful controls and open next questions are included. Rohan Arun/PR1972, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991 and the retained schedule/native/geometry contributors retain credit. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Hosted CI is separate.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
